title: Compute brief — 17 September 2026
description: Anthropic locks first Australia lease at Zerra Western Downs (2.16 GW peak path, FIRB/council gated). ERCOT State & Community Impact RFI clocks Batch Zero to Oct 12. Silicon Tape confirm day — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69; 69 confirms, 0 ticks.
lede: Australia posts the clearest overnight conversion print while Texas tightens the audit paperwork. Queensland Premier Crisafulli told Parliament on 16 Sep that Anthropic signed its first Australian data-centre lease as anchor tenant at Zerra DC’s Western Downs Digital Park near Dalby — planning docs put ~1.44 GW IT / ~2.16 GW peak grid at full build, first use targeted 2027 for inference, still gated by FIRB and council DA (Anthropic/Zerra no comment to Reuters). On the US grid side, ERCOT’s 14 Sep Market Notice M-B091426-01 put a State & Community Impact RFI on Batch Zero and medium data centers with notarized answers due 5pm CPT 12 Oct, plus TWDB water questions under a same-day Governor letter; PUCT Project 58481 still shows no stamped Order Adopting through Interchange item 217. The Silicon Tape is another clean confirm: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged across 69 re-read list prints.
